overview_description.description: Ogram is an on-demand staffing platform that connects businesses with a flexible hourly workforce across industries like retail, hospitality, logistics, and events. It enables companies to quickly hire vetted workers for short-term shifts while providing workers with flexible earning opportunities. Ogram uses technology to streamline scheduling, workforce management, and payroll, improving operational efficiency and labor scalability.
